purpose: Railway resolves world time, NPC activity, location, travel ETA and availability before a named character may enter a scene.

time_advance.default: zero minutes; Railway never advances time merely because another turn was generated
time_advance.small_step: minutes for played dialogue or continuous action, with scene evidence
time_advance.medium_step: tens of minutes for played/summarized meal, training, work or travel
time_advance.large_step: more than two hours or a date boundary only after explicit player intent to wait, sleep, rest, travel or timeskip
forbidden: skipping an unresolved immediate answer window
using a timeskip to invent Akira's action, consent, thought or motive

rules: set_activity and set_availability never change location
cross-location NPC movement requires start_travel followed by arrive
a travel delay extends ETA instead of teleporting the character
a newly present NPC must have committed present/nearby/available state in the scene location zone
remote contact must be explicit and does not make the character physically present

local_presence_denied_when: sleeping without a played reason to wake/contact
different location zone without committed arrival

npc_autonomy.principle: Named NPCs keep doing their own work, recovery, social or personal actions offscreen and may delay, refuse, leave or solve a problem without the player.
forbidden: making an absent NPC witness the current scene
turning calendar or runtime state into NPC knowledge
forcing an NPC to abandon duties because the player wants them available

raider_accountability.accountability_window: from the character's waking/available morning block until 16:00 local world time
raider_accountability.core_rule: If a raider is not on a raid, the day before 16:00 must contain at least one substantive block. Nobody forces continuous training.
raider_accountability.ordinary_rule: Eating, resting, talking and sleeping are legitimate parts of a day; they become an accountability concern only if the whole available block reaches 16:00 without any substantive or justified recovery block.
raider_accountability.consequence: Railway creates a pending staff observation, not punishment. Staff may form a conclusion or report it to Ray only if someone witnessed or reviewed the day in-world.
raider_accountability.training_effect: Regular training lowers overload risk; missing it raises risk but never guarantees an outburst.
raider_accountability.lesson_effect: Lessons lower tactical errors, casualties and uncontrolled emotional/energy reactions; skipping them raises risk but does not predetermine failure.

ignored_event_rules.deadline_behavior: An unresolved open/triggered event with due_at at or before the new clock becomes missed and produces world pressure.
allowed_consequences: another NPC proceeds with their own goal
an NPC becomes less available or more suspicious
a task worsens, moves or is handled offscreen
forbidden_consequences: inventing what Akira did during the missed window
inventing Akira's consent, refusal, thought, emotion or motive
giving absent characters knowledge of an unseen scene
